title: Backend Engineer — Node.js
description: We need an experienced Backend Engineer with 5+ years of Node.js development to join our platform team. You will design and build high-performance microservices, own the API layer, and work closely with DevOps on Docker and AWS deployments. Strong experience with MongoDB, SQL databases, and REST API design is essential.
responsibilities: Design and build scalable Node.js microservices
Develop and maintain REST APIs consumed by web and mobile clients
Optimise database queries for MongoDB and PostgreSQL
Containerise services using Docker and deploy on AWS
Write unit and integration tests for all backend services
requirements: 5+ years of backend development with Node.js and Express
Strong understanding of REST API design principles
Experience with MongoDB and relational databases
Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
